name: Hagsville
detailed_description:
An abandoned town. A cursed house. A darkness that refuses to rest.

After leaving a difficult chapter of your life behind, you’ve settled into a quiet, isolated house in a town most people have long forgotten. It was affordable, secluded—perfect. But there’s something unsettling about this place. Locals call it “Hagsville,” a name whispered with unease, born from rumours of witchcraft and unspeakable events that linger from the past.

Strange noises echo through empty rooms, shadows seem to shift, and it feels like you’re never truly alone. To feel safer, you’ve installed a smart monitoring system, allowing you to watch every room. But in a place like this, will that be enough?

Features

  • Dynamic Haunting: Experience an escalating horror as an unknown presence inches closer. As the night wears on, it finds new ways to breach your defences.

  • Smart House Defence System: Use your tablet to control lights, alarms, and locks throughout the house. Every second counts as you try to outsmart whatever lurks within.

  • Uncover the Town’s Dark Past: Piece together the chilling history behind “Hagsville” and the secrets hidden within your house through books, letters, and forgotten objects.

  • Survive the Night: As the terror escalates, you’ll need all your wits to survive until dawn—or risk becoming another lost soul bound to this cursed place.
